item.title: Social media companies are using AI and face scans to spot more kids on their platforms

Of the child safety measures agreed to in Meta’s landmark legal settlement, no category contains more detailed requirements than its commitments on age assurance—and for good reason. No matter how well the protections work, they are of little use if Meta can’t tell which users are kids....

item.title: GoPro stock is soaring after YouTube star Markiplier buys an 8.5% stake
item.description: The YouTube star has become GoPro’s largest individual shareholder, giving the struggling camera maker a sudden boost and drawing comparisons to GameStop’s Roaring Kitty. For most of August, shares of GoPro traded for about 60 cents as the once-lauded action-camera maker faded toward what seemed like a near-certain delisting and possible collapse. But as September kicks off, the stock is soaring, at least compared with its previous levels. Shares were up nearly 80% at one point Tuesday as investors found renewed hope for the company. And it’s all thanks to a YouTube creator....
